exposure: preference for prenatal cardiology visit location
perceived need for high-risk maternal-fetal medicine involvement
outcome: knowledge of cardiac care during pregnancy
attitudes towards cardiac care during pregnancy
perceptions of cardiac care during pregnancy
cohort: The participants were 77 pregnant women with congenital heart disease (CHD) who completed an anonymous survey at a national Adult Congenital Heart Disease conference.
finding: Despite seeking medical care, pregnant women with CHD did not demonstrate a full understanding of their condition and cardiovascular risks during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Only 35% of the surveyed women discussed modes of delivery with their healthcare providers.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at a national Adult Congenital Heart Disease conference.
